The adapter's source-R gate is correct and produces no clear-air cloud hallucination, but the opening frames contain no visible V3 cloud footprint from which the required macro coverage can be reviewed.
No rendered volume reaches the Earth surface/limb, so cloud-to-ground attachment and planet-relative parallax cannot be established.
No V3 cloud volume is present in either raw or full output; base, core, top, depth and self-occlusion are therefore not readable.

Telemetry and the full composite confirm the shared native temporal and AerialPerspective path is active; the failure is the V3 opening representation, not a native feature being disabled or replaced.
The V3 frames contain no continuous bright-white shell. This is not counted as a visual pass because the required cloud volume is absent.
